name: Curve Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Curve Finance tweeted that a vulnerability was found in the Pool Factory v1 version of the fund pool, and it is recommended that v1 users use crv.finance to withdraw funds immediately. Curve.fi and Pool Factory v2 fund pools do not respond. But it only affects the v1 pool, and hackers cannot use it to steal user funds.
